title: Basalt.Meridian.S01E09.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: RAR4 store-method set across three volumes with `-p` data encryption and readable headers. The router derives RAR4 keys off the header's file salt and routes the encrypted member direct; the output is byte-identical to the conventional path, so the direct-store counters are the witness.
